direct_delivery.description: Evidence that a polymeric or polypeptide material carries, transports, presents, or enables uptake of antigen, vaccine cargo, proteins, mRNA, or other biomacromolecules.
direct_delivery.canonical_question: Does the candidate-containing polypeptide/polymer material deliver, carry, enable uptake of, or present antigen, protein, vaccine cargo, mRNA, or other biomacromolecules?
target_paper_types: polypeptide/polymer/nanoparticle carrier studies for antigen, protein, vaccine cargo or mRNA
cellular uptake or antigen-presentation studies where the candidate-containing material participates in delivery
vaccine-delivery or biomacromolecule-delivery studies with explicit material composition
not_the_primary_target: free amino-acid metabolism without a candidate-containing material
papers that only mention the amino acid in sequence tags or unrelated proteins

intracellular_endosomal.description: Evidence about cellular internalization, intracellular trafficking, endosomal localization, endosomal escape, or endosome-related delivery behavior.
intracellular_endosomal.canonical_question: Does the candidate-containing material show cellular internalization, intracellular trafficking, endosomal localization, endosomal escape, or related intracellular delivery behavior?
target_paper_types: endosomal localization/escape or intracellular trafficking studies
mechanistic delivery studies of candidate-containing polymers, polypeptides or nanoparticles
not_the_primary_target: generic cell biology papers with no candidate-containing material
sequence tags used only for purification or detection unless the tag materially affects delivery

safety.description: Evidence about cytotoxicity, toxicity, hemolysis, membrane damage, viability, biocompatibility, or related safety outcomes.
safety.canonical_question: What cytotoxicity, hemolysis, membrane damage, viability, biocompatibility, or other safety evidence exists for candidate-containing polypeptide/polymer materials?
target_paper_types: biocompatibility/safety studies of candidate-containing polymers, polypeptides or nanoparticles
not_the_primary_target: toxicity of unrelated drugs merely delivered by the material
clinical toxicity papers with no candidate-containing polymer or polypeptide

immune_activation_dc.description: Evidence about dendritic-cell activation or maturation, antigen presentation or cross-presentation, adjuvant activity, immune activation, immunotherapy, or vaccine immune responses.
immune_activation_dc.canonical_question: Does the candidate-containing material contribute to dendritic-cell activation/maturation, antigen presentation/cross-presentation, adjuvant activity, vaccine responses, or related immune activation?
target_paper_types: immunotherapy studies where the candidate-containing material has an interpretable immune role
not_the_primary_target: papers where the amino acid appears only as a purification tag or incidental sequence feature
immune papers where the candidate-containing material has no interpretable role in the intervention
